 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Malick Yalcouye scored another Thursday night goal as he helped his national team to an important win.
 And there was playing time for Yankuba Minteh as he returns from minor ankle surgery.
 A week on from his winner for Albion at Getafe in the Conference League, Yalcouye opened the scoring for Ivory Coast in a 2-1 home win over Gambia.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement It was his second goal in three starts for his country and secured three points in the race to qualify for the next AFCON finals.
 Minteh, who has had little playing time off the bench since suffering injury in pre-season, played the second half for Gambia.
 Albion will be delighted to see the winger building fitness, providing all goes well from the injury point of view.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Yalcouye's goal rewarded quick thinking both by him and Nicolas Pepe.
 From an unopposed drop ball not far outside the Gambia penalty area, Yalcouye made a run in behind the defence which Pepe spotted.
 He immediately lofted a pass over the defence which Yalcouye took down on the run before clipping a shot over the goalkeeper.
 Both teams had won their opening two games and they will meet again on Tuesday in Bakau on Africa's west coast.
